Injectables, Skin Quality & Tightening

Anti-Ageing & Injectables in Bangalore

Anti-ageing care in Whitefield, Bangalore, planned around your anatomy and what you would like to change. Every treatment starts with an assessment, and nothing is recommended before it.

Call the Clinic

Measured, Anatomy-Led Planning

Lines from movement, lost volume, skin quality and laxity are different concerns, and each responds to a different kind of treatment. At NeoSculpt6, Dr Sandeep Mahapatra assesses your face or treatment area, your history and previous treatments before recommending anything.

The aim is a proportionate change that suits your face and age. Your consultation explains the suitable options, how long effects may last, the risks and aftercare, so you can decide with clear information.

  • 01

    Facial assessment

    Anatomy, movement, volume and skin quality are assessed together.

  • 02

    History

    Previous injectables, medicines and health conditions that affect suitability.

  • 03

    Measured planning

    Conservative, proportionate plans rather than a fixed package.

  • 04

    Consent

    Products, risks, limits and aftercare explained before you decide.

  • 05

    Review

    A follow-up to check your response before any further treatment.

    Lines from movement

    • Botox

  • 02

    Volume or profile

    Lost volume, or the balance of the lips, cheeks, chin or jawline.

    • Dermal Fillers
    • Lips
    • Jawline
    • Under-Eye
  • 03

    Skin quality

    Dryness, dullness, crepiness or uneven texture.

    • Profhilo
    • Skin Boosters
    • PDRN
  • 04

    Laxity

    Looser skin along the jawline, neck or under the chin.

    • HIFU
    • RF Tightening
    • Thread Lift
  • 05

    A body concern

    Volume or skin concerns beyond the face, such as the hands or body.

    • Hand Rejuvenation
    • Body Fillers

Your Consultation

From Assessment to Review

Your health, medicines, allergies and any previous injectable or energy-based treatment.

Anatomy, movement, volume, skin quality and laxity, and what you would like to change.

Whether a treatment suits you now, and when another option or no treatment is better.

The suitable product or device, the areas and a conservative amount.

Risks, how long effects may last and their limits, explained before treatment.

What to do and avoid in the days after treatment, and who to contact with a concern.

A follow-up to check your response; results and how long they last vary between people.

    Quick Answers

    Anti-Ageing FAQs

    Lines from movement, lost volume, skin quality and laxity each respond to different treatments. The doctor assesses your face or treatment area and explains which options may suit you and why.

    Plans aim for a proportionate change that suits your face and age, using conservative amounts. How you respond varies, and a review appointment checks the result.

    It depends on the treatment, the product, the area and your body. Your doctor explains a realistic range for your plan rather than a fixed time.

    Injectables and energy-based treatments can cause temporary swelling, redness or bruising, and rarer risks that are explained at consultation. Aftercare and who to contact are part of your plan.

    No. They are considered only after a medical assessment of your health, history and goals, and may not be appropriate for you.

    Cost depends on your assessment, the product or device, the areas, the amount or number of sessions, and follow-up, so it is explained after your consultation rather than quoted in advance.
